canonical_example.text: Siento mucho aprecio por Gabriel porque él siempre estuvo cuando lo necesité.
canonical_example.translation: I hold Gabriel in great esteem because he's always been there for me when I needed him.

canonical_example.text: Aprecio mucho una buena taza de café cuando hace frío en la mañana.
canonical_example.translation: I really appreciate a good cup of coffee when it's cold in the morning.

canonical_example.text: Sinceramente aprecio tus consejos.
canonical_example.translation: I sincerely value your advice.

canonical_example.text: Eres un excelente amigo y te aprecio mucho.
canonical_example.translation: You are a great friend and I am really fond of you.

canonical_example.text: Le tengo el mayor aprecio a tu madre. Es una mujer ejemplar.
canonical_example.translation: I have the highest regard for your mother. She's an exemplary woman.

canonical_example.text: Ricardo es una persona que goza del aprecio de sus vecinos.

canonical_example.text: Fue Mendoza Vaca quien realizó el aprecio de los bienes del duque fallecido.

canonical_example.translation: Not coming first made Quique angry.

canonical_example.text: Me enfada que algunos tengan tanto y otros tan poco.

canonical_example.translation: Yesterday a bank was robbed and its safe emptied.

canonical_example.text: Dos hombres enmascarados nos asaltaron a punta de pistola y nos robaron el dinero destinado al pago de sueldos.
canonical_example.translation: We were held up at gunpoint by two masked men who stole the money intended for wages.

canonical_example.text: Un ladrón intentó asaltar a la viejita, pero la policía lo atrapó en el acto.
canonical_example.translation: A thief tried to mug the old woman, but the police caught him in the act.

canonical_example.translation: The armed revolutionaries stormed the fortress.

canonical_example.translation: The terrorists were caught before they could attack the office building.

canonical_example.translation: The reporter seemingly accosted the group of refugees outside the hostel.

canonical_example.translation: When Sofia came back from the party her parents bombarded her with questions.

canonical_example.text: De pronto me asaltó una gran idea para salvar el negocio.
canonical_example.translation: Suddenly, I was struck by a great idea for saving the business.

canonical_example.text: El miedo me asaltó en medio de la noche y ya no pude dormir.
canonical_example.translation: I was seized by fear in the middle of the night and I couldn't sleep as a result.

canonical_example.text: Cuando te toca firmar el documento, te asaltan las dudas.
canonical_example.translation: When it's your turn to sign the document, you're assailed by doubts.

canonical_example.text: ¡Soy afortunada de tener tan buenas amigas!
canonical_example.translation: I'm lucky to have such good friends!

canonical_example.text: Me considero muy afortunado de tener tan maravillosos amigos.
canonical_example.translation: I consider myself very fortunate for having such wonderful friends.

canonical_example.text: Me alegro de verte de nuevo; fue un encuentro afortunado.
canonical_example.translation: I'm glad to see you again; it was a happy encounter.

canonical_example.text: No sabía que tú también venías a esta fiesta. ¡Qué coincidencia tan afortunada!
canonical_example.translation: I didn't know you were also coming to this party. What a fortunate coincidence!
